material_delta_summary: Fresh PR head adds a RED adversarial fixture for QV-EDL-V02-008. The fixture correctly encodes canonical-appraisal binding and anti-wash acceptance requirements, but self_origin_evidence.py is unchanged and still accepts caller-authored trust/alignment plus any non-empty appraisal_binding_hash. The fixture is research acceptance evidence only, not a repair and not C PASS.

why: It asserts that an arbitrary non-empty appraisal_binding_hash cannot make caller-supplied high trust/alignment eligible.
It asserts that post-appraisal trust mutation and post-appraisal anchor-alignment mutation must fail closed.
It preserves the existing anti-wash requirement that distinct event IDs on one shared lineage count only once.
It does not modify SelfOriginEvidenceChain or expand Spirit authority scope.
current_kernel_recheck: ExperienceEvidence still contains free trust and anchor_alignment fields.
SelfOriginEvidenceChain still checks appraisal_binding_hash only for non-emptiness.
Self-origin score still directly consumes event.trust and event.anchor_alignment.
No canonical DerivedAppraisal bytes/ref, appraisal-policy identity, or anchor-registry binding is recomputed during eligibility evaluation.
qv008_red_fixture_recheck.required_repair_semantics: SelfOriginEvidenceChain must consume or dereference a verified canonical DerivedAppraisalEnvelope and derive trust/alignment/context evidence from pinned appraisal artifacts. Binding must cover event/fingerprint, verifier envelope, appraisal-policy identity, anchor-registry identity and canonical serialization. Historical origin remains immutable; STABLE_CANDIDATE is always a new derived object with lineage.

runtime_pulse_red_fixture_recheck.required_repair_semantics: Decay must be a function of explicit trusted elapsed cognitive time or a bounded reconciliation/metabolism tick, never runtime pulse count. With identical elapsed cognitive time, 0/1/10000 runtime-only pulses must produce identical cognitive/personality-relevant state; only separately scoped runtime diagnostics may differ.

resolved_in_shadow_candidate.boundary: OWNER_SEEDED/GOVERNANCE_DERIVED require explicit authority_scope_ref + scope_hash + source_authority_evidence_hash; EXPERIENCE_CANDIDATE is shadow-only and cannot carry executable scope. No drive/desire-to-authority inference is permitted.
Goal surfacing remains proposal-only; evidence sufficiency and cadence thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED; external action and canonical personality writes remain forbidden.

LIVE_SHADOW_ADOPTABLE requires an external monotonic anchor and bound workspace identity; RESEARCH_ONLY unanchored mode remains promotion_evidence_eligible=false. Provider authority, installation binding and crash reconciliation remain TEST_REQUIRED and require independent B/C verification.

open_bounded_vetoes.finding: SelfOriginEvidenceChain still accepts trust and anchor_alignment as free ExperienceEvidence fields and only requires appraisal_binding_hash to be non-empty. The new RED fixture makes this defect reproducible but does not repair it.
open_bounded_vetoes.required_change: Make SelfOriginEvidenceChain consume a verified DerivedAppraisalEnvelope/reference directly; recompute/validate appraisal binding and derive trust/alignment/context evidence from pinned appraisal artifacts. Historical origin remains immutable; STABLE_CANDIDATE must be a new derived object, never relabel-in-place.

open_bounded_vetoes.required_change: Decouple cognitive decay from runtime pulse count and drive it from trusted elapsed cognitive time or a bounded reconciliation/metabolism tick.
